edges.label: Command-level reaction to the encounter series
edges.note: The message describes exactly the problem Graves's squadron reported - repeated near-midairs with unidentified objects in working airspace - and was withdrawn within 24 hours.

edges.label: January 2015 ATFLIR artefact from the same operating environment
edges.note: GO FAST is the video Gallaudet says was attached to the recalled Fleet Forces Command safety message, and the one AARO later reanalysed on parallax grounds.

edges.label: AARO parallax reanalysis: no anomalous speed or flight characteristics
edges.note: AARO's SASC case slides place the object at roughly 13,000 feet at about 45 mph with 60-knot winds. The analysis addresses apparent speed; it does not address the recall of the fleet safety message built on the same footage.
